summary: Controller object of the shared message window (0x7C bytes): owns the two side windows and the name-plate/backdrop/page/style child panes, holds the active text/animation panes and the current key-handler pair plus pending command index, and embeds its UI node id 0x16F at +0x60. NOTE: the batch name cluster also contains fields of other, larger Ui_MessageWindow_* objects (menu/message composite, battle work); those are carried as unknown_* with confidence 0, so the generated sizeof (0xE08C) is inflated and must be ignored until the cluster is split.
evidence: Ui_MessageWindow_Ctor 0x001C560C installs vtable 0x007597F4 and returns self; maybe_Ui_ReleaseGfxResources 0x00216B5C and Ui_UpdateWindowParts 0x00216DD4 allocate it with Mem_AllocAligned_2(0x7C) and call the ctor; Ui_NodeList_Register(self+0x60,1,0x16F) builds the embedded UI node; Open/Close/Tick/Update drive f_c/f_10/f_3D/f_52..f_5D. The batch's offsets above +0x7C come from other objects M1 also named Ui_MessageWindow_* (a 0x3940-byte menu/message composite, a battle work block at 0x3240, etc.) and are documented as unknown here.
